svg.title: TRACI Hook Cam - Battery and Supporting Equipment - 3 of 3
svg.desc: Revision v3. Original master hook restored on page 1 at 18 percent opacity. Native editable SVG text and layout, embedded replaceable raster product images. Three-page datasheet; references maintained separately.

g.text: Portable energy, cellular communication and local audible alerting.
Dependent on usable energy and total load
Subject to final pack and enclosure design
Use a regulated DC / PoE supply matched to the battery voltage range. reCamera Pro accepts 12-24 V DC; TF02-Pro requires
5-12 V DC. A 24 V-class battery must not be assumed compatible with direct connection.
4G LTE with deployment-region bands; Ethernet uplink; external antennas.
Specify VPN / remote access, DC input range and power consumption.
DC-input PoE injector with regulated output. Confirm camera PoE standard /
power class, battery voltage coverage and Ethernet speed.
External audible alert unit with a matched DC supply and control interface.
Specify dB(A) at 1 m, tone, duty cycle and ingress protection.
Battery, router, siren and PoE values are configuration targets. Final system dimensions, weight, enclosure rating and operating time
